attack: measure each qubit in a guessed basis, then resend it as a re-made chip
passRule: one re-made chip goes to the cashier and every qubit must agree; this does not model both of two copies passing

perQubit.method: Qiskit statevector over every bank state and attacker basis

limits.byLengthMethod: perQubit to the power of length, because the qubits are independent with no entangling gates

payouts.rule: fair total return times 0.95, with net profit on a 100 stake rounded down to a multiple of 5

logicalCircuitsNote: each circuit is one example ticket, the first of the ideal run's stream; every simulator shot used a fresh ticket

noiseModel.name: fake_kingston
noiseModel.qubitSelection: best-case pick: the qubits with the lowest readout plus single-qubit gate error in the snapshot, ranked best first; length n uses the first n
noiseModel.scope: gate and readout errors on the chosen qubits only; no decay during the mid-circuit measurement

provenance.qubitSelection: best-case pick: the qubits with the lowest readout plus single-qubit gate error in the day's calibration, ranked best first; length n uses the first n
